item.title: Endeavour Silver suspends Terronera mine operations after illegal blockade in Mexico
item.description: Endeavour Silver suspended operations at its Terronera mine in Jalisco, Mexico, from Aug. 12 due to an illegal community blockade. Blockade remained peacefu
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Endeavour Silver suspended operations at its Terronera mine in Jalisco, Mexico, from Aug. 12 due to an illegal community blockade. Blockade remained peaceful; the site stayed staffed with a reduced workforce to maintain safety, security, and essential maintenance access. Talks continued with local Ejido leaders to end the disruption and restart production as soon as possible. Legal action remains an option if the stoppage persists. item.title: Episurf Medical agrees to buy 49 properties from Lilium, Setune; closing set for Aug. 31, 2026
item.description: Episurf Medical lined up financing to complete purchases of 49 properties from Lilium and Setune, with closing set for Aug. 31, 2026. Deals financed via Gol
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Episurf Medical lined up financing to complete purchases of 49 properties from Lilium and Setune, with closing set for Aug. 31, 2026. Deals financed via Goldcup 40207 AB issuance of senior secured bonds (2026/2030) up to SEK 550 million at 5.6%. Bonds mature Aug. 31, 2030; certain company assets pledged as security. Agreed property values total SEK 945.5 million, split between SEK 660 million for Lilium and SEK 285.5 million for Setune. Group expects cash and cash equivalents above SEK 200 million following completion, debt repayments, transaction costs, and issue costs. item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Marfrig posted 2Q26 net revenue of R$ 40.72 billion, up from R$ 38.8 billion in 2Q25. item.title: Volvo CE invests $40 million to expand Shippensburg, Pennsylvania factory output
item.description: AB Volvo expanded production at its Shippensburg, Pennsylvania plant, lifting U.S. output to more than 50% of North American supply. First U.S.-built excava
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: AB Volvo expanded production at its Shippensburg, Pennsylvania plant, lifting U.S. output to more than 50% of North American supply. First U.S.-built excavators, larger wheel loaders shipped to customers; 11 additional models to start production at the site. Localization plan targets customer lead times cut by more than six weeks. Most recent investment totaled USD 40 million; cumulative investment since 2007 exceeds USD 1.4 billion to raise capacity, upgrade skills. Purchasing plan targets a 30% increase in business with Pennsylvania-based suppliers by 2030; counterweight supplier investing more than USD 1.5 million locally. item.content:encoded: Olenox posted a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $3.24 million for Q2 2026, narrowing from $4.57 million a year earlier. item.title: Vivakor Q2 2026 gross profit climbs 44.86% to $6.63 million; revenue rises 10.37% to $32.12 million
item.description: Vivakor posted revenue of $32.12 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, up 10.37%. Gross profit rose 44.86% to $6.63 million, on higher profitability
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vivakor posted revenue of $32.12 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, up 10.37%. Gross profit rose 44.86% to $6.63 million, on higher profitability across midstream operations and $1.06 million from supply and trading. Operating expenses fell 42.97% to $6.48 million, driven by lower depreciation and amortization after the July 2025 divestiture. Interest expense edged down 7.12% to $4.12 million; unrealized gain on marketable securities was $346,871. May financing included up to $12 million gross proceeds in two closings via convertible promissory notes, alongside a $100 million standby equity purchase agreement.
